files.title: File:Dharmaraja Ratha-Mahabalipuram-Kanjipuram-Tamil Nadu DSC00039.jpg
files.author: Midhun D Raj
files.desc: This incomplete shrine is a larger version of Arjuna Ratha. It has an added course on its pyramidal roof. The temple roof, like most in India, is covered with repeating elements (fractals). It has a typical South Indian design consisting of small "model" shrines at various scales of size, false windows, and horseshoe-shaped arches. It has little barrel-shaped rooflets on the side of the roof and squared rooflets on the corner of the roof. The building is topped by an octagonal shikhara (dome).
